description: This PHP file defines the AOS_Invoices class, extending it from AOS_Invoices_sugar, and implements methods for saving and deleting invoice objects in the SuiteCRM application. It includes functionality for generating invoice numbers, handling related line item groups, and custom save logic.

classes.name: AOS_Invoices
classes.description: Subclass of AOS_Invoices_sugar, providing customized save and delete functionalities for invoice records within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that calls the parent constructor to initialize an instance of AOS_Invoices.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Overrides the parent save method to include custom logic for generating invoice numbers, handling POST data, and saving related line item groups.

methods.name: mark_deleted
methods.description: Overrides the parent method to mark an invoice and its related line items as deleted.
